description: Vulnerability in the Oracle BI Publisher product of Oracle Analytics (component: BI Platform Security).  Supported versions that are affected are 8.2.0.0.0, 12.2.1.4.0 and  26.01.0.0.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows high privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle BI Publisher.  While the vulnerability is in Oracle BI Publisher, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change).  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle BI Publisher. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 9.1 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H).
